reports.title: DPC Holdings Reports Record Third Quarter 2026 Results

guidance.heading: Full Year 2026 Outlook Raised – New Full Year 2027 Guidance Provided
section: We have raised our FY 2026 outlook because of strong business performance. We have introduced FY 2027 outlook which includes our controlling interest in MPP and total capital expenditure relating to our fifth strategic partnership. Ivostud is excluded post divestment on October 23, 2026.

Guidance | Previous FY 2026 | Updated FY 2026 | Introducing FY 2027
Low | Mid | High
Revenue(1) | $1,000m - $1,040m | $1,115m - $1,130m | $1,230m | $1,280m | $1,330m
Adjusted EBITDA(2) | $182m - $187m | $204m - $207m | $240m | $250m | $260m
Adjusted EBITDA margin(1,2) | ~19% excl. metal inflation | ~18% ~19.0% excl. metal inflation | ~19.5%
Adjusted earnings per share(2) | $1.00 - $1.10
Free cash flow(2) | ($20m) - $20m
Unallocated corporate expenses | ~$23m | ~$23m | ~$30m
Depreciation and amortization | ~$30m | ~$31m | ~$35m
Net interest(3) | ~($90m) | ~($105m) | ~$0m
Effective tax rate(4) | N/A | N/A | ~27%
Total capital expenditures(5) | ~$55m-$60m | ~$67m-$77m | ~$145-$170m
Option-based compensation scheme(6) | ~$40m | ~$40m | ~$40m
Weighted average shares(7) | 132m | 132m | 149m

(1) | Including metal cost inflation pass-through assuming no material change to metal cost.
(2) | The Company has not reconciled guidance related to Adjusted EBITDA, Adjusted EBITDA margin, Adjusted earnings per share and free cash flow to the most directly comparable forward looking GAAP financial measures because such information is not available, and management cannot reliably predict all of the necessary components of such GAAP measures without unreasonable effort or expense.
(3) | 2026 guidance increased due to loss on extinguishment of debt as a result of the debt refinancing completed in September 2026, of approximately $21.5 million. 2027 minimal interest expected as a result of IPO proceeds and refinancing.
(4) | On a normalized, steady-state basis – assuming full utilization of group tax attributes and no permanent disallowances – the Group’s blended effective tax rate is approximately 27%.
(5) | 2026 increase due to buying MPP’s land and buildings. 2027 increase due to Strategic Customer Partnership #5 and a UK building purchase.
(6) | Option-based compensation is a new scheme, non-cash.
(7) | 2026 includes only 6 months of IPO shares issued.
